newsitem.title: USA: Biofield Corp discusses filing with FDA.
newsitem.headline: Biofield Corp discusses filing with FDA.

text.p: Biofield Corp said on Monday it began discussions with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration about the status of its filing for pre-market approval of its Alexa breast-cancer diagnosis system, a filing the FDA rejected last month.
Biofield said the Alexa system can detect breast cancer through the skin, in a non-invasive, objective procedure.
The company said discussions with the FDA "to clarify issues in connection with the filing review" may continue for weeks or perhaps longer.
